rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for a television or radio news anchor.

example.traditional: 呢位新聞主播講嘢好清楚。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 san1 man4 zyu2 bo3 gong2 je5 hou2 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this for the main host of a non-news television or radio programme rather than specifically a news anchor.

example.english: This anchorman hosts the interview programme very energetically.
example.traditional: 呢位節目主持人主持個訪談節目好生動。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 zit3 muk6 zyu2 ci4 jan4 zyu2 ci4 go3 fong2 taam4 zit3 muk6 hou2 sang1 dung6
